messages:
miguel.procure: Hey @vendor_delta — quick ping on the H100 tranche ETA. Ops shows 12 units allocated to our EU pool but we only received 6 and 4 returned as DOA. Any update on replacement ETA and whether replacements will be air or sea?

vendor_delta: Sorry for the noise — we shipped 12 by sea (AWB XZ123456789). Carrier flagged a customs hold in FRA and then a partial DOA detected on arrival. We can expedite 4 replacements by air next-week if you cover expedite fee (~$1.8k/unit) or switch to sea with expected arrival in ~3 weeks.

sasha.ops: Do we have the DOA serials? Alyssa, can you confirm depot processing times if we go air?

alyssa.logistics: I have the serials. DOA list: H100-SN-0912, H100-SN-0913, H100-SN-0920, H100-SN-0921. Depot turnaround for air-replace is typically 48–72h once units land. Need confirmation on customs HS code for faster clearance.

miguel.procure: vendor, can you confirm if replacements will be new or refurbished? Also need vendor credit for the 4 DOA units — per contract we expect either refund or credit + arranged replacements.

vendor_delta: Replacements will be refurbished from our EU pool (clean room tested). We can also offer credit of 90% for DOA unit cost if you prefer refund route. For air, we can do new units but lead time is +2 business days for provisioning. For customs, HS code is 8471.80 — should speed clearance.

sasha.ops: Refurb is ok but would like swapped units with matching thermal binning. Also need matching firmware versions or we risk incompat in fleet. Can your refurb team confirm firmware >= v2.4?

vendor_delta: Confirmed — refurb units will be flashed to v2.4 before ship. We'll add a note in the AWB and include serial manifest.

alyssa.logistics: If we take the air option, please confirm the AWB and cost split. We budgeted for partial expedite but need to know vendor credit to reconcile. Also, can we consolidate AWBs to a single courier pickup at FRA to simplify depot intake?

vendor_delta: AWB for air replacements will be AWB-EXP-7788. We can consolidate to single pickup. For cost: vendor covers 50% expedite fee per our SLA clause 4.2; remaining 50% Redwood covers. We'll issue a credit memo for the 4 DOA units at 90% unit cost to be applied to next invoice.

miguel.procure: Put that in writing and attach an RMA reference so finance can track. Use RMA-2026-0345. Alyssa — proceed with air if depot ETA meets 72h SLA.

alyssa.logistics: Roger. I'll book courier once vendor confirms pickup window. Two quick asks: 1) can vendor provide a digital serial manifest (CSV) with manufacture date and batch so we can reconcile against inventory? 2) Please confirm if replacements will require a customs indemnity letter.

vendor_delta: We'll attach CSV: columns serial, sku, mfg_date, fw_version, refurb_flag. No indemnity letter needed because value on AWB matches commercial invoice and HS code applied.

warehouse_bot: NOTE: Received DOA check-in request 1784567901. Assigned to depot EU-FRA-DC3. ETA verification pending.

sasha.ops: Thanks. Also, small ops ask — can we route replacements to our dedicated pool (tag: eu-dedicated-01) instead of general pool to avoid mixed thermal bins?

vendor_delta: Yes — we'll set destination to eu-dedicated-01 in the AWB instructions.

miguel.procure: Great. Finalize the cost split and vendor credit in email. I'll approve expedite cost share after finance sign-off. One more: please include a photo of packaging damage for the original sea shipment — helps with insurance claim.

vendor_delta: Uploading photos and CSV to the shared folder now. Link: https://files.vendordelta.com/redwood/h100/1784567890.

alyssa.logistics: Courier booked for 2026-04-12 06:00Z pickup at FRA. Depot will queue replacements under RMA-2026-0345; expected in-depot tts 48h after arrival.

miguel.procure: Sweet. Tagging @finance for the credit memo follow-up. :money_with_wings:

finance (via DM): miguel.procure — will validate vendor credit once CSV and invoice adjustments arrive.

sasha.ops: I'll update the provisioning scoreboard and block those 4 units until replacements land. Thanks everyone.

vendor_delta: Thanks — will send final confirmation email with AWB, manifest CSV, photos, and credit memo reference within 2 hours. :white_check_mark:
